# VLC / libVLC 3.0.24 Windows amd64

Official portable VideoLAN distribution, pinned URL and SHA-256 in manifest.json. Run scripts/fetch-deps.ps1 to verify and extract; the complete runtime/plugins/licenses is packaged alongside the desktop. LibVLC renders directly to a Windows child HWND. No VLC transcoding or sout pipeline is configured. Source: https://code.videolan.org/videolan/vlc/-/tree/3.0.24 . Upstream licensing notices and source references remain included in the portable distribution.
